scope.revision: Actual final MP4 independent visual review
scope.method: Viewed all10 actual-MP4 clause pair sheets containing38 selected shot frames, all3 operation strips, and all3 chunk-boundary sheets. Compared visible object/action/state/values with each clause. Extraction and technical QA do not establish visual acceptance alone.
scope.passMeaning: Core spoken meaning visibly represented at the sampled state. Does not mean every authored pointer/click/attachment/gesture is implemented, or that the user has approved the aesthetic.

boundaryCheck.observed: No black frame, empty reset, or abrupt disappearance/state jump seen in these81 boundary samples. Typing and endcard state remain consistent across sampled boundaries. Coarse samples are not continuous playback.

operationsObserved: Opening prompt visibly reveals from short text at0.23s to full text at1.23s.
3D planes show meaningful icons and labels; focused step changes through initial/check/decision at44-49s. These are symbolic step diagrams, not full source documents.
Tone edit is represented by readable before/after panels. No sampled literal deleting/typing motion for this edit.
Large numeric counters tween toward13 and15 while the log already shows final example values. No real elapsed-time measurement inferred.
Comment example progressively reveals at75.10,75.90,76.67s. CTA is a mock interface, no actual public action.
